Insights

Matcha's Insights screen as a plugin: streak and this week, books finished,
days read, total time, longest streak, sessions and average session, a month
calendar and your books, with a tab per book language. Open a book for its
own page: sessions, time, average session, days read and a calendar marking
the day you started and the day you finished.

Open it every dozen reading sessions or so: sessions wait in a small queue
(4 KB) that the firmware drops if it overflows. Needs the clock set.
